resources.string: Require a double tap to confirm answer to prevent accidental inputs
The Stroop test is a test of selective attention. Traditionally, subjects are shown a colour word written in a different colour font, and must respond with the colour of the font.
Read more about the Stroop effect on Wikipedia
The first mode, Colour Mode, is like the traditional Stroop test. You should select the colour of the font.
In colour mode, given the word RED in blue text, you should choose blue
The other mode, Word Mode, is the opposite. You should select the colour that corresponds to the meaning of the word.
In word mode, given the word BLUE in red text, you should choose red
The game will switch between the two modes at random.
Your goal is to last as long as possible while answering as quickly as possible. Good luck!
Hey! You need to keep those skills sharp. Come play a bit of Stroop Swap!
